notes.title: Tinkertown 2.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/f082164fbfb310d9ec04f9e2861bd39ceea0fe38.png[/img]

Hi Tinkerers, 

It’s finally here, the Tinkertown 2.0 Update! With this new update, you will discover a revamped version of the world map with a new biome, bosses, and much more! 

[b]New World Map[/b]
With the new revamped version, you will see a difference in where all the biomes are located, and the map is no longer circular. Each biome is also much larger than before, so you have more key points of interest to find and explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/45385b3715110fc1501798c3e4db0a9466f2d106.png[/img]

[b]New Lava Biome[/b]
The Lava Biome introduces new treacherous areas to explore, and it can get extremely hot, so make sure you're wear the proper equipment before venturing inside! 

With the new biome, there will be new monsters for you to encounter and a new dungeon to explore. Are you up for the task? 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rsT7vJbq/2.gif[/img]

But wait, that's not all!  We’re bringing in a whole array of new furniture, walls, and flooring to the game. NPCs will also receive unique pieces to decorate their homes and much more! 

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New World Map
[*] New Biome: Lava Biome
[*] New Lava Dungeon
[*] New Lava Volcano Dungeon
[*] New Enemies in the Overworld, new Elite Mobs
[*] New and Updated Bosses
[*] New Quests
[*] A bunch of new Weapons and Armor
[*] New Tools
[*] Endgame Tool
[*] Many more decorations and items
[*] 3 New Plants to grow 
[*] New recipes
[*] 3 New Fish (exclusive to Lava)
[*] New Rod for fishing
[*] Lava Larva as bait
[*] New Ore Meteorite
[*] New Stone Category Basalt
[*] New Wood Category Ashwood
[*] Expanded/Updated Journal
[*] New Reward Level for all NPCs
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional Map Markers to ease exploration and questing
[*] Player markers now look like the actual player character
[*] Playerlist for current Session in Pause Menu - Displays all current connected Players
[*] Shared/Synchronized Exploration
[*] Pausing of Singleplayer Session via Pause Menu
[*] Added icons for the current quest state above Townian heads
[*] New fancy particle systems
[*] New animations for weapons, combat and teleportation
[*] Added progress bar 
[/list]

[b]Technical Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Massively Improved Performance
[*] Lowered Memory Consumption/Requirements
[*] Unification of Tinkertown Client and Server - Previously it was possible that the firewall blocked the Tinkertown Server Application even for Singleplayer
[*] Steam Cloud Save
[*] Improved synchronization of objects, events and combat
[*] Improved Combat Hit Detection
[*] Pre generation of the whole world upon first loading
[*] Improved Crash handling
[*] Various Bug Fixes and Improvements
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] When talking to npc, and then without closing interact with any other interactable, the next interaction with the first npc may not work before opening inventory once. (mouse and keyboard only)
[*] When placing tiles to where sage the elder initially spawns and you didn’t build a house for her yet, she may not spawn until you remove the tile that blocks her spawn
[*] When the host leaves the game you may get the connection lost popup multiple times before being thrown back to the main menu
[*] When a quest is given to questgiver because it is finished, the quest dialog will open for other players, they will need to close it
[*] For Clients, the playerlist button in the pause menu is missing a spacer
[*] Community rewards are not in the game yet but they will come.
[*] In internal tests there were issues where the game may crash in trap rooms
[*] The "Smart Transfer" is in the game, but the keyboard and mouse players do not have buttons for it yet
[*]Freeing tina or Kiran from their prisons, non host players may not see the door as open
[/list]

We are working on all the Known Issues, and will provide with an smaller update as soon as they are fixed. 

Enjoy the new update!
[i]The Tinkertown Team[/i]

notes.title: Developer Update April
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/12ed1b20a00e00a6b4157d9cc9e5afdf5fe729c9.png[/img]

Greeting fellow tinkerers, 

It’s been a few moons since the last update, and we are now back to share some more information about what we have been up to! Last year, we talked about a major project that we started working on with a new database rework that is going to help us with performance and much more. Work is moving forward and will soon be ready to be released with a major update, but let’s jump in and look at the progress and what you will get your hands on soon.   


[b]New biome, monsters, and dungeon! [/b]

Since last time, the team has been focused on the lava biome, adding several points of interest, new enemies, and finalizing a new dungeon for you to explore. The lava biome can get extremely hot, so make sure you're wearing the proper equipment before venturing inside.  


Just like our other dungeons, you'll need to find the missing pieces to unlock the entrance to the boss. But be warned, the road is treacherous and filled with traps. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rsT7vJbq/2.gif[/img]

[b]New things to catch and craft! [/b]

Some fishes have already adapted to the new biome. So, in the upcoming update, we will introduce several new species. With the right gear, bait and strategy, you might be able to catch what's swimming beneath the fiery lava rivers - just be careful! 

But wait, that's not all! We are also adding a bunch of new furniture pieces, walls, and flooring to the game. NPCs will also be getting new and unique pieces of furniture to decorate their homes and additional rewards. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGKH87Cb/1.gif[/img]

[b]Database Rework [/b]

We have been working on reworking our database to improve its stability and performance. Currently, save files consist of more than 10,000 individual files, which can negatively affect performance, particularly on slow hard drives. As a result, the game will now run smoother overall. The new save game is an SQLite file, which will enable us to introduce more complex changes in the future without compromising existing player saves. Additionally, this will allow very invested players to modify save games to match their preferences. However, we want to make it clear that this is NOT mod support. 

We do not want to give away too much, so there are plenty of surprises waiting for you in the upcoming update. We are currently putting the final touches on it, as well as preparing something exciting. Keep an eye on our social media or join our [url=https://discord.gg/sU46TSjMdP]Discord community[/url] to stay updated! 
 
The Tinkertown Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.8 and the way forward! 🛣️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/81c4cf23e2fa7a691da15b6f718f3842f5a2d01b.png[/img]

Dear Tinkerers,

It's been a few weeks since our latest dev blog, and we wanted to give you an update on where we are currently at. We’ve been working hard to optimize the overall experience of Tinkertown, especially from a technical perspective, and we will continue to do so for some time.

This means that our programmers are putting almost all their time into transforming the game backend towards a database structure, and optimizing the performance. Still, we're taking what time we have left to improve other features in the meantime.😊

[b]Therefore we’re now releasing patch 1.0.8.![/b]

Looking at your feedback on Steam and Discord, you mentioned that new quests and follow-up quests were hard to spot. In 1.0.8, we’ve added an indicator on each NPC to show whether there’s a new quest, and updated the icons within the quest UI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/b6691fdaba034dfa762160ffbb01f830c7935d0b.png[/img]

One of the other bigger requests from you was some sort of guidance system that helps players through quests. A way of making it easier to find the right places, monsters and required materials and items.
Unfortunately, the current Tinkertown backend does not support such a system, but the new database structure in development will let us add it. This support feature will be implemented from the start when we release the new backend in the future!

[b]What’s next for Tinkertown?[/b]

The 1.1 update will include the promised NPC Rewards, from decoratives to friendly critters, monsters and whatever more we can cook up until then!

We also have a certain creepy holiday coming up soon, maybe that will be reflected in Tinkertown…

That brings us to the last, and most important bit: [b]your feedback![/b]

We’d love to focus our work on the issues you feel need to be tackled the most, please let us know your thoughts [url=https://forms.office.com/e/02JjAgw2bq]in this feedback form[/url]. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we will make sure to follow up on the results of the form in a future Steam post.

Thanks for your continued engagement!

Your Tinkertown team

notes.title: Statement regarding shared user data within our game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/90b011cc9bd324b7ffc7dae94cebf3961f767c9f.png[/img]

Dear Tinkerers, 

In the past few days, we have received several reports from you regarding our game unintentionally accessing your microphone data and collecting data from you during gameplay. To avoid confusion, we would like to address these raised concerns clearly and explain exactly what happened in this case. 

[h1]The Short Version:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Due to a bug in version 1.0, PlayFab’s voice chat feature could be enabled in multiplayer under certain circumstances, putting you in a private voice chat lobby. 
[*] With version 1.0.1, this bug was fixed. According to PlayFab, no audio data is stored or processed. We have never had access to audio data. 
[*] The option to share anonymized user data with us via Unity Analytics is unrelated to the microphone bug. 
[*] We cannot attribute this anonymized user data to any natural person. 
[*] The shared data contained only in-game events like items crafted, quests completed, etc, which would have helped us balance the game. 
[*] Since version 1.0.2, we have completely disabled the option to share anonymized user data via Unity. In 1.0.2 it was greyed out, and later completely removed in 1.0.3. 
[*] With the latest update, you will find an EULA at the beginning of the game. You now have the opportunity to trace in detail which data Tinkertown accesses and whether and how it is processed by us or external partners. 
[*] This EULA must be accepted to play Tinkertown. [url=https://headupgames.com/EULA_v7_Tinkertown_28.06%20en-GB.pdf]You can read it beforehand on our homepage[/url]. 
[*] We’re sorry for any confusion and inconvenience this may have caused. 
[/list]

[h1]The Full Explanation:[/h1]

[h2]Microphone Usage in Tinkertown[/h2]

To enable multiplayer sessions in Tinkertown, we utilize the "PlayFab" service from Microsoft Azure. This SDK supports the ability to access your microphone for features such as in-game voice chat or text-to-speech analysis. Version 1.0 of Tinkertown contained a bug that could activate your microphone under certain conditions and started a private voice chat within PlayFab, even though we had no intend to use this feature. After you brought this issue to our attention, we fixed this bug with version 1.0.1. 

 We consulted with PlayFab regarding the implications for your data. PlayFab assured us that voice audio is never stored anywhere. If the network connections were relayed connections, the voice data would have passed through the nearest Azure region used by PlayFab’s service, determined by QoS latency measurements per player. Since Tinkertown never used any accessibility features like speech-to-text, the data would not have been processed at all, only relayed. 

If the players were connected through a peer-to-peer network, their voice data would not have passed through the relay at all and would have traveled via the internet. Approximately 92% of connections were P2P in the last 6 months. All traffic sent via Party, including voice, is encrypted. 

Our team never had access to your voice transmissions at any time, and we still do not have the ability to access your voice data. 

[h2]Shared User Data [/h2]

To continually improve Tinkertown, there was an option for you to share anonymized data with us via Unity. Until version 1.0, this option was enabled by default. The anonymized data helped us make adjustments to the player experience and fix bugs. This anonymized data could not be attributed to any specific player. 

With the release of version 1.0, some users raised concerns that this option was enabled by default. With version 1.0.1, we added a pop-up dialog at the first game launch, asking if you would like to share this anonymized data with us or not. 

It is important to emphasize once again that the anonymized data you could have shared with us had no connection to the microphone bug. These are two completely unrelated topics. 

However, due to the confusion caused by these reports we have decided, as a precaution, to completely disable the option to share anonymized user data with version 1.0.2. Consequently, the option in the menu is currently grayed out. Since version 1.0.2, there is no way to share user data. This means that when you start Tinkertown now, you do not need to decide whether you want to share anonymized user data because we aren’t collecting user data. 

[h2]What Happens Next [/h2]

First and foremost, we would like to apologize for the inconvenience caused. It took us some time to recognize and address all the issues and seek advice on how to handle such cases. Our team has made significant efforts in improving this situation in the past few days. We understand that you were and still are concerned, and we would like to prevent that from now on with the latest update. 

From now on, when you start the game for the first time, you will find an [url=https://headupgames.com/EULA_v7_Tinkertown_28.06%20en-GB.pdf]End User License Agreement (EULA)[/url] where you can read all the details about how services can access data from Tinkertown and in what manner. This EULA must be accepted to start playing Tinkertown. If you do not agree to the EULA, you will not be able to play Tinkertown. With this approach, we aim to provide the highest level of transparency, allowing you to play Tinkertown without any uneasiness. Within the EULA, you now have the opportunity to trace in detail which data Tinkertown accesses and whether and how it is processed by us or external partners. 

We hope that this step will help us regain your trust. The reviews criticizing our game have deeply affected us. We would like to ask you to give Tinkertown a second chance, and we would be grateful if we could alleviate your concerns about your data through this explanation.  

If you have any further questions, we are here to assist you. 

Your Team at Headup

notes.title: The Road Ahead
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/67702bb714106c955641cf51c9433115499390c1.png[/img]

[b]Dear Tinkerers,[/b]

When we first started developing Tinkertown 3 years ago, we never expected it to turn into this huge and beautiful world full of adventures you can experience today. Throughout the years we were able to watch our team, Tinkertown’s features and most importantly you, our community, grow. We are more than thankful to be able to work on this project and are equally grateful for your continuous support and feedback. After all the hard work that has been put into the game, we are happy to share that we are getting close to the end of Early Access for Tinkertown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/0a2146059c9a5c0d41746fdb3dec3c574b9927e6.jpg[/img]

But before we’ll be launching this huge project into 1.0, we still have some work and awesome features pending for the game to reach its full potential

Let’s be honest: Our game still has a few rough edges, including features we’ve implemented but needed to cut out again (yes, I’m looking at you gathering for NPC:s!) and some that have yet to find their way into the game (we’re not exclusively talking about the Lava Biome). However, this is going to change! As you might have seen in the last two months since our last bigger update, we’ve focused on smaller patches and will continue to do so on a regular basis, as well as keeping YOU informed about what’s happening behind the scenes. Don’t fret, even though we call them smaller updates, they contain much more than you think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/b0da736bd58c70b2480c425a25060eb3d7369abf.jpg[/img]

[*] Quest Rework: A new interface to keep track of every quest you’re doing and have been doing and its rewards
[*] Updated UI: An easier-to-read UI, crafting stations, as well as a library to check for every recipe out there!
[*] A new NPC feature: We will dedicate this topic more space at a later time, but it will keep you much more engaged in supporting and getting to know your new neighbors
[*] New Map: An updated World Map, as well as a new tool to make it easier to navigate through ;)
[/list]
Additionally, we are preparing various iterations of our current system (including, but not limited to):
[list]
[*] Dying in dungeons will be more forgiving
[*] Adjustments on Biome Flora for better exploration
[/list]

Thanks again for being so supportive and for your help in building our beloved Tinkertown,
your Tinkertown Team!

notes.title: ⚔️ The Tinkertown "Combat and Classes" Update is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YV9n6Za8ma4;full][/previewyoutube]
Greetings fellow Tinkerers, 

Bring out your weapons and put on some gear! It's time for a new adventure with the Combat and Classes update! The update brings unique playstyles, charge abilities, new monster attack patterns, and much more!

[b]Charge-Attack:[/b]
Works only on Weapons (Swords, Daggers, Spears, Axes…)

[b]Combat:[/b]
Knockback function (player or monsters will be knocked back on hit)
The anticipation frame is reduced (Monsters attacks will happen sooner!)
Buddy-list (Enemies close to the ones a player attacked will react and might attack the player as well)

[b]Dash:[/b]
By jumping and in midair pressing the jump button a second time, you “dash” quickly in the direction you jumped at, being able to cross more space until landing. During the jump and dash, you’ll stay invulnerable to a lot of attacks.

[b]Monster Behaviour:[/b]
New monster's attack patterns for Goblins and Slimes; Introducing the "buddy system" that will cause certain monsters to attack in a group.

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/E9ICS-Y2Mcyx6zIpSS1Ctfn7ua-VzDOkFK5LL2RZtFzeDsYQNyJRftmgAesYwfJJrUZ_4xvsmW8x1Oo-YQPov4W9XzCOIJxyg3im81kGCg8WmkEYcJgoll7b51QzuSAgRfvC6Z-orgMXEX2PWko[/img]

[b]Balancing:[/b]
Monster resistances and immunities (Certain Monsters might not be affected by some Conditions/Debuffs, or the effect is reduced)

Player-Scaling (Enemies scale less in proportion to the number of players)

[b]Stats and Balancing:[/b]
Added Dexterity and Magic (stats are added to the player base from Armors)
Weapon-Scaling (determined by specific Stats, a Weapon deals more or less damage, depending on the amount of points a player has in them) 

Formula rework (how damage is applied, how armor is applied [+1 armor equals 0.5 damage reduction]

Some dishes and food Items change their targeted attributes to accommodate for the added stats

[b]Gear:[/b]
Gear will use all Attributes, including the new Magic and Dexterity, to determine a player's stats. Armor sets usually aim to prioritize certain stats to cater to a specific Weapon Category and a playstyle. Armor-parts can still be worn as a player wants to, giving the stats they provide without any bonus or penalty on their own. 

[b]New Weapon and Armor Sets:[/b]
[list][*] 2 New Mage Sets
[*] 2 New Ranger Sets
[*] 4 New Weapons (Desert Mage's Staff, Frost Mage's Staff, Oak Dagger, Ice Bow)[/list]

Greetings fellow Tinkerers, 

The new Combat and Classes Update is now available on the preview branch! You can now jump over and try out all the latest features and give us your feedback before it's fully released next week! 

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Characters and worlds created or used in the Preview Branch might become [b]CORRUPTED[/b], so we [b]HIGHLY[/b] recommend [b]NOT[/b] to use your original characters or gameworlds while playing on the Preview Branch. 

[b]How to access the preview branch:[/b]
[img]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/EgF4g5Qyo2PLgeBXdw0zMIdWw1YafJCkC5h-FhJ7xar_GDjQch6a1pbrMGjsAFCMh6eJkdVKLtFeB2JZVYhDsjielN-QKgzcVBUvM-gN3fKKb1D9g0disctudAtiNJztkDkjJYzLeiquPjOqSHE[/img]

Here is a list of all the new features and changes we have made:

[b]Charge-Attack:[/b]
Works only on Weapons (Swords, Daggers, Spears, Axes…)

[b]Combat:[/b]
Knockback function (player or monsters will be knocked back on hit)
The anticipation frame is reduced (Monsters attacks will happen sooner!)
Buddy-list (Enemies close to the ones a player attacked will react and might attack the player as well)

[b]Dash:[/b]
By jumping and in midair pressing the jump button a second time, you “dash” quickly in the direction you jumped at, being able to cross more space until landing. During the jump and dash, you’ll stay invulnerable to a lot of attacks.

[b]Monster Behaviour:[/b]
New monster's attack patterns for Goblins and Slimes; Introducing the "buddy system" that will cause certain monsters to attack in a group.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
Monster resistances and immunities (Certain Monsters might not be affected by some Conditions/Debuffs, or the effect is reduced)

Player-Scaling (Enemies scale less in proportion to the number of players)

[b]Stats and Balancing:[/b]
Added Dexterity and Magic (stats are added to the player base from Armors)
Weapon-Scaling (determined by specific Stats, a Weapon deals more or less damage, depending on the amount of points a player has in them) 

Formula rework (how damage is applied, how armor is applied [+1 armor equals 0.5 damage reduction]

Some dishes and food Items change their targeted attributes to accommodate for the added stats

[b]Gear:[/b]
Gear will use all Attributes, including the new Magic and Dexterity, to determine a player's stats. Armor sets usually aim to prioritize certain stats to cater to a specific Weapon Category and a playstyle. Armor-parts can still be worn as a player wants to, giving the stats they provide without any bonus or penalty on their own. 

[b]New Weapon and Armor Sets:[/b]
[list][*] 2 New Mage Sets
[*] 2 New Ranger Sets
[*] 4 New Weapons (Desert Mage's Staff, Frost Mage's Staff, Oak Dagger, Ice Bow)[/list]
[b]New Enemy:[/b]
Rune Spirit

[b]4 New NPCs + 20 New Quests:[/b]
Armorer, Blacksmith, Bowyer, and Wizard

If you want even more insight into the new update, you can read our Developer's blog, which showcases the new features and break them down even further:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1276660/announcements/detail/3316354736734413486

We always want your feedback, so head over to our Discord and let us know what you think about the new update and what you would like to add!

notes.title: Player Scaling beta and the Super Pixel Bundle
notes.content:
Dear Tinkerers,

welcome to 2022. We hope you had some time to rest and relax and made it well into this new year, and now let's take a look at what we have in store for you!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24079/Super_Pixel_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/fe165f2ebf2b46e273c0bb97f600c051ffe2dacc.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Super Pixel Bundle[/h3]

First of all, today our publishing team at Headup launched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24079/Super_Pixel_Bundle/]Super Pixel Bundle[/url] that includes three wonderful games, all joined by their aesthetics: The crazy classic RPG Pixel Heroes, Super Treasure Arena and Tinkertown. 

The bundle will be there for a long time (if not for forever^^) and gives you 15% off for getting all the three titles. In addition to the aesthetics part of our team, they have also been part of the devs that made Pixel Heroes and Super Treasure Arena. 
In case you already own one or two of the games in this bundle, you can still purchase the bundle and will only pay for and receive the games you do not own including the discount.

Getting back to Tinkertown we’re currently working on several new features, most prominent and almost finished: controller support and key-rebinding. This update will not just include the ability to plug in almost any modern controller you like to play Tinkertown with and the option to remap any button on controller or keyboard, but also updates the UI and gives you some quality of life features.

And while you are waiting for this update to arrive, we’ve just pushed another feature to the preview branch: 

[h3]Player-Scaling[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/f4a568e7590c66c985a2651cbb0a8508ac5573aa.gif[/img]

From now on, the world of Tinkertown will adjust to the amount of players participating in any fight. Monsters will only grow stronger if multiple players are close-by and get weaker again after a bit, once the number of players has shrunk.
Please keep in mind that we’re doing a lot in terms of balancing and will do so according to your feedback too. So please use the Steam forums and/or our Discord and let us know what you think.

Last but not least, we’re still in the middle of updating the roadmap and will soon deliver a new one. Combat & classes will be linked as one big update, housing and NPCs will be delivered and of course there’s a new biome & dungeon coming! In addition we’ll be unveiling the unknown in the roadmap this year too!

Expect more updates soon.

Much love,
Your Tinkertown Team

[b]the Ice Dungeon is here![/b]
It has been quite some time since the last big update and we’re really pleased to announce that you are now able to enter the frozen city that lies beneath the snowy tundra.
Packed with a range of new enemies, bosses and so much loot, the Ice Dungeon amps the content up to a new height!
In addition, we’ve updated the overworld and the progression system. This includes the adventure mode but also the sandbox version:
Make sure to visit the God of Death inside the Desert Dungeon again, to prepare for the updated ice biome which provides new ressources: 
Instead of silver and gold you’re able to obtain crystal and orichalcum. At the same time it has gotten a bit colder. When entering the ice biome you’ll need clothing or buffs to keep you warm as the cold weather steadily chips off your health.

Inside the Ice Dungeon you will encounter deadly foes, consumed by something dark and an eastern inspired setting offering various decorations and of course new weapons and armor.
Levers and switches can be found to unlock paths and a new item will help you cross over water and abysses very easily.

To enter the dungeon and obtain the new resources you’ll need to create a new world. 

And since this update is part of the Thunderful World showcase and feature, Tinkertown is 33% off for a short time!

notes.title: 🌲 The Forest Dungeon Rework Update is live + 30% Discount! 🌳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/bbe5d4aea0b4bee786cf71a72f30dbde50c4b68e.jpg[/img]

Greetings Tinkerers!

The new Forest Dungeon is here and we’re celebrating the occasion with a [b]30% discount[/b]!

We had a blast opening the Desert Dungeon a while ago and promised to give each Biome the same love, which means each of them each need to get a great Dungeon. With that in mind, it was just fair to get back to the Forest and rework what’s hidden underneath this enormous Skull-Entrance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/9f702197960325c64c2a0c4da81be825fca9d9ef.jpg[/img]

At the same time, the refreshed Forest Dungeon Update will lead [b]Tinkertown[/b] into a new experience [b]if[/b] players wish to do so: [b]Progression![/b]

[i][b]Let’s have a quick look at all the goods that Patch 0.8.1 will introduce:[/b][/i] 
[list][*] An overhauled Dungeon and a new Boss to challenge! (We will miss you Golem!)
[*] 3 new and dangerous enemy types
[*] A new optional Progression System to guide fresh and seasoned players alike through the world of Tinkertown
[*] A World Map with Location Icons of each Dungeon accessible by using the craftable Globe. (You still have to get there yourself, though!)
[*] New Weapons (including a reworked Boomerang), Armor Pieces and Magic Wands!
[*] Additional bonus movement speed on player crafted Floors! 
[*] A new dish and a super cute decoration to brighten up your room: Baby Oakling[/list]
Attention! To enjoy everything but the Progression System, you [u]do not need[/u] to start a new world! Instead can just continue with any of your characters and worlds at hand! 🙂
 
[i][b]Now… What is this “progression”?[/b][/i]
Since Tinkertown’s first launch, we sensed at some point it would be awesome to introduce a mode besides the Open world one, raising the challenge for exploration, while simultaneously introducing a common thread that loosely guides the player through the biomes.

It’s called “Adventure Mode” paves the way to a deeper lore of Tinkertown, yet to be discovered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/2b4ca2036ee3556281f6589dca949a68ca6b876b.jpg[/img]

[i][b]And what’s next?[/b][/i]
Of course we are aware that there are three biomes but just TWO Dungeons! And the Progression System is not fully implemented into the other biomes yet, therefore watch out for our next big update:

[b]The ICE Dungeon![/b]

And now without further ado, enjoy the new Update and happy dungeoneering!

As always, your opinion is highly appreciated! Please send us all your feedback, feature request and bugs to the pinned Forest Dungeon Rework thread in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1276660][b]Tinkertown Community Hub[/b][/url] or reach out directly to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/N7wf2gq][b]Tinkertown Discord server[/b][/url] and get involved with the rest of our awesome community!

Cheers
Your Tinkertown Team!

notes.title: Multiplayer Update is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/5f5d171eefce2a42a73bdd97c624f8d216eccdf6.jpg[/img]

Greetings Tinkerers!

As you may know (from your own experience), we had to deal with multiplayer connection issues between players since the early access release of [b]Tinkertown[/b]. It was an urgent issue that prevented many players from enjoying [b]Tinkertown[/b] together with their friends and family.

Since then, we worked constantly to find the root of the issue, gathered your bug reports and tried to deliver workarounds to the best of our abilities and still develop new content simultaneously. Some of the workarounds and the UPnPsupport patch helped some of the players, but not everyone.

[b]But today is the day we can finally announce the release of our major Multiplayer Update![/b]

We put a lot of work into the update and reworked the multiplayer of [b]Tinkertown[/b] significantly.

For example, [b]Tinkertown[/b] now uses the “PlayFab Party” service for online multiplayer. We updated the network code, fixed issues where players could not connect to each other, allow players to play offline, and [b]even solved some issues where some players were not able to start a single player game![/b]

[b]The update should finally be the solution for all players to connect to each other reliably and without any issues.[/b] And we hope that you’re all able enjoy the improved multiplayer experience!

This update is a big leap for us, and we are already on track for the [b]next major content update[/b].

[b]Early Access 0.5.0 Patch Notes:[/b]
[list][*] Multiplayer now uses "PlayFab Party" service
[*] Fixed plenty of issues where players could not connect to each other
[*] Implemented cloud-based relay servers, allowing players with strict NAT types to connect
[*] Improved NAT punchthrough
[*] Improved data encryption between server and client endpoints
[*] Updated network code
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not play single player while offline
[*] Fixed an issue where maps could not be deleted from within the ingame menu
[*] Players can now save multiple maps with the same seed
[*] Improved server performance and memory usage
[*] Updated intro splash screen[/list]
So stay tuned for more information and teasers about the next update.
We would love to get your feedback!

We love to get in touch with you, so feel free to join our [b]Tinkertown[/b] community Discord:

And follow us on Twitter for wholesome tweets, giveaways and GIFs:

notes.title: Come to Tinkertown: The Early Access Gates are open!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/356cfd32821a3f6091cf5c8fc1d70e6068064f69.jpg[/img]

Hello fellow Tinkerers! 

A small step for mankind, but a big step for us at Headup: [b]It’s finally Tinkerday![/b] ːsteamhappyː

We have been around for over a decade, porting and publishing independent games from great external development teams. But now we are treading into uncharted waters by delivering our first fully internal production, launching today into Early Access and giving our baby into your hands, hoping that you will treat it kindly.

[previewyoutube=P1kfq0e6WQ4;full][/previewyoutube]
With [b]Tinkertown[/b], we are realizing a design idea which has been floating in our heads since the beginning of our partnership with Re-Logic years ago for whom we had the honor to create the PC Collector’s Edition of Terraria. Huge respect for this game and the genre and lovingly having spent our childhood exploring the kingdom of Hyrule has led to the clear vision: Creating a cheerful sandbox game in the aesthetics of the old 16bit RPGs but leveraging the possibilities of modern game development such as visual effects, online multiplayer and more. And bringing the original composer of The Secret of Mana OST on board this project was a true dream come true to our inner fanboys.

Today we are making the foundation of this vision available to you and are super-excited and partially scared of the feedback to come. We honestly hope that you will understand that this is meant to be the beginning of a wonderful journey together and far from being a full game release.

Because of this, it is extremely important to give you a better understanding on what is about to come and how we are planning to grow the game with you. For this reason, we are sharing our roadmap today – which of course is not set in stone as it so very much also depends on you, the players, providing us with your feedback and wishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37573477/85fdd3258ee4633135dcf604cc7c81a94aad19f8.jpg[/img]

There are so many things planned to give the game more depth over time, both horizontally with more biomes, enemies, NPCs, furniture, recipes, etc. as well as vertically by introduction of new mechanics, items, gear, loadout, dungeons, bosses and much more. Please check our roadmap image and feel free [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/TqWMkVU]get in touch with us on Discord for more details[/url][/b].

Now, enough of the babbling, we have a game to launch! Thank you for your support, your love and your kindness and see you all in [b]Tinkertown[/b]!
- Team Tinker

Hello everyone!

[b]PAX Online[/b] is just around the corner, and [b]Tinkertown[/b] is going to be part of it!

Whether you want to get your hands on the game early, or you've already played the demo at gamescom and you're hungry for more - We've got you covered! From September 12th to September 20th you'll have the chance to play the limited-time demo again!

You're also invited to play, laugh, and tinker with us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/uepCnJ2]Discord[/url][/b]!

All the best and happy tinkering!
- Team Tinker
